_comment: GOLDEN EVALUATION DATASET — ARC Raiders WikiBot
A set of test questions with expected keywords that a correct answer
should contain. This is the foundation of systematic RAG evaluation.
WHY KEYWORDS INSTEAD OF FULL EXPECTED ANSWERS?
LLM answers are non-deterministic — the exact wording changes every
time. Checking for specific keywords (weapon names, map names, game
mechanics) is a robust way to verify the answer is on-topic and
contains the right information without brittle exact-match checks.
The script loads this file, asks each question through the pipeline,
and checks how many expected keywords appear in the answer.
- Add more questions covering edge cases and new game updates
- Add 'category' tags to group questions by topic
- Add 'difficulty' to track easy vs hard questions separately
- Eventually add full expected answers for deeper comparison
